test_title: PYST 38 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

She dug a **__well __**behind the cottage to access groundwater.

options.text: He was feeling well after a week of illness.
The well had dried up due to drought.
She lowered the bucket into the deep well.
They built a stone wall around the old well.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. He was feeling well after a week of illness**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"well"** has two main meanings: • **Meaning 1 (Adverb):** "Well" means in a good or satisfactory way. (अच्छा) • **Example:** He was feeling well after a week of illness. • **Meaning 2 (Noun):** "Well" refers to a deep hole or shaft dug into the ground to obtain water or oil. (कुआं) • **Example:** The well had dried up due to the drought. • In the given sentence, the homonym "well" is used as an adverb, meaning "feeling good or healthy." Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. He was feeling well after a week of illness**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: The well had dried up due to drought** (कुआं सूखे के कारण सूख गया था।) • Here, "well" is used as a noun referring to a water source. • **Example:** The villagers were worried as the well had dried up completely. • **Option 3: She lowered the bucket into the deep well** (उसने बाल्टी को गहरे कुएं में नीचे किया।) • In this sentence, "well" is again used as a noun referring to a deep hole for water. • **Example:** The old man showed her how to draw water from the well. • **Option 4: They built a stone wall around the old well** (उन्होंने पुराने कुएं के चारों ओर पत्थर की दीवार बनाई।) • Here, "well" is used as a noun referring to the structure for water storage. • **Example:** The stone wall was built to prevent accidents near the well. 3b:Td61, The correct answer is **Option 1**.
